title: Reset VPN Password
content: Open the Self-Service Portal, choose 'Reset Network Password', complete MFA, and wait 2 minutes before reconnecting VPN.

title: Fix Outlook Not Syncing
content: Check internet connectivity, restart Outlook, then recreate your profile from Control Panel > Mail if sync issues continue.

title: Laptop Battery Health Check
content: Run the vendor diagnostics app and submit the generated battery report to IT support if health is below 60%.

title: Corporate Wi-Fi Troubleshooting
content: Forget the corporate SSID, reconnect using your company credentials, and verify your device time is set automatically.

title: MFA Unlock for Account Access
content: Open the identity portal, choose 'Unlock Account', verify with backup method, and wait 5 minutes before retrying sign in.

title: Laptop Screen Flicker Troubleshooting
content: Update graphics drivers, disable adaptive refresh, test with an external monitor, and raise a hardware ticket if flicker continues.

title: Office Printer Offline Fix
content: Power cycle the printer, verify LAN cable or Wi-Fi signal, then remove and re-add the printer profile from system settings.

title: SSO Login Loop Resolution
content: Clear browser cookies for company domains, sync device time, and retry login in an incognito window before escalating.
